svg.title: 418 passages, placed by meaning
svg.desc: Seven small maps of the same 418 passages, flattened from 3072 dimensions by t-SNE; in each, one chapter's passages are coloured and numbered by article, the rest are grey.
svg.text: Each dot is one passage; dots that are near each
other have similar vectors. One panel per chapter.
neighbours stay near; distances far apart are not to
